private.t_audit()|CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.t_audit()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'api'
AS $function$
begin
  insert into api.audit(actor,via,op,app_id) values (private.login(), case when private.is_ai() then 'ai' else 'human' end, tg_op, coalesce(case when tg_op='DELETE' then old.id else new.id end,0));
  return null;
end $function$

private.consume(text,integer)|CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.consume(p_op text, p_app integer)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'api'
AS $function$
declare v bigint;
begin
  select id into v from api.confirmation where actor=private.login() and op=p_op and app_id is not distinct from p_app and created_at > now()-interval '10 minutes' order by id limit 1 for update;
  if v is null then raise exception 'Требуется подтверждение человеком (%)', p_op using errcode='42501'; end if;
  delete from api.confirmation where id=v;
end $function$
